hints.title: Mismatch Boundaries
hints.text: Examine boundaries where two consecutive characters differ.

hints.title: Prefix or Suffix Inversion
hints.text: To reconcile mismatched neighbors, one must invert either the left prefix or the right suffix.

hints.title: Local Greedy Optimal
hints.text: Greedily choose the smaller cost between the left prefix length and right suffix length for each adjacent mismatch.

hints.title: Linear Cost Accumulator

variables: n: length of binary string s
complexity.notes: Single pass accumulating minimum inversion cost per adjacent difference.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating string inversions recursively explodes exponentially.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that adjacent differences must be inverted through the closest end.
